title: Thurston norm and the Euler class
summary: In his influential work, Thurston introduced a norm on the second homology group of compact orientable 3-manifolds M, which by duality also determines a dual norm on the second cohomology group. A natural question, initiated by Thurston, is whether integral points on the boundary of the dual norm ball have a geometric interpretation.
